api_docs.description: Programmatically manage short links using the Sink Open Platform API. All endpoints accept JSON and require a bearer token issued from the API Keys page.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: All endpoints are served from your Sink instance. Replace the origin below with the domain where this instance is deployed.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Send your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Keys are minted, scoped, and revoked from the API Keys page.
auth.keys_hint: Generate a key on the API Keys page.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Each key is granted one or both scopes. Requests are rejected with 401 when the key lacks the required scope.

endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.description: Routes in the table below accept API keys. Other endpoints under /api are reserved for the dashboard session.
endpoints.verify: Verify the current bearer token and return identity information.
endpoints.link_query: Look up a single short link by slug and domain.
endpoints.link_list: List short links with pagination, filtering, and sorting.
endpoints.link_search: Search links by keyword, exact URL, tag, status, or domain.
endpoints.link_count: Count links matching keyword, URL, tag, status, or domain filters.
endpoints.link_tags: List every tag currently in use across stored links.
endpoints.link_create: Create a new short link on a registered domain.
endpoints.link_upsert: Create a new short link or return the existing one when the slug already exists.
endpoints.link_edit: Update an existing short link in place. The domain field is read-only.
endpoints.link_delete: Delete a short link by slug and domain.

interactive.title: Interactive documentation
interactive.description: Need to try a request end-to-end? The Scalar UI lets you browse the full schema, send live requests with your bearer token, and copy generated snippets.
